name: Consensus

field_reviews.reason: The OpenAPI spec at docs.consensus.app/reference/v1_quick_search secures the endpoint with securityScheme XApiKeyHeader: type apiKey, in header, name x-api-key.

REST uses x-api-key; the official MCP docs (docs.consensus.app/docs/mcp) show OAuth sign-in for Claude/ChatGPT/Claude Code/Codex/Cursor and 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' for enterprise/other MCP clients. The draft correctly scopes OAuth to the MCP connector, not the REST API.

consensus.app/home/api states verbatim: 'The Consensus API is available by application only. Our baseline pricing starts at $0.10 per call, plus a platform fee. Apply today to receive a custom quote.' A public API exists and is publicly documented, but there is no self-serve key generation - access is application/quote-gated, so contact_sales is the right classification. The 'OAuth requested' hint matches the MCP OAuth flow, which is self-serve (even without an account, 3 papers/search).
docs.consensus.app/reference documents a single endpoint, GET /v1/quick_search (read-only paper search); the docs index shows nothing broader.
REST quick_search endpoint at api.consensus.app plus official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp.

docs.consensus.app/docs/mcp (vendor-owned docs domain) documents the server at mcp.consensus.app/mcp with search/fetch tools and plan-based result limits. Independently confirmed docs.composio.dev/toolkits/consensus.md returns 404, so no Composio toolkit.

The REST API is fully documented but key issuance requires an application and custom quote; meanwhile the MCP path is self-serve. Partially buildable with a sales/application gate on direct API access is accurate.
'Available by application only' with custom quotes is an application/sales gate; no self-serve API key path exists anywhere in the docs.

notes: Adversarial focus per hint: confirmed a real public REST API exists (documented OpenAPI for GET /v1/quick_search with x-api-key) but access is genuinely application-only with custom pricing - not self-serve. Opened the draft's consensus.app/home/api and docs.consensus.app evidence URLs directly; both match the draft's quotes. Verified the official MCP at mcp.consensus.app/mcp uses OAuth (self-serve, works even without an account at reduced limits) and Bearer API keys for enterprise. Composio toolkit 404 re-confirmed. All eight fields hold.
